basis: Source-confirmed one horizontal expression with nested fractions and fractional evaluation limits; existing production glyph-row separation and fraction ownership rules. No existing test was read as specification.
fixtures: Independent integer-coordinate connected glyph primitives in Boolean arrays. No native PNG/crop is loaded or displayed; no source pixels or author content are used to construct expectations.

cases.expectation: One mathematical row plus four independent body context rows equals five; source Boolean arrays unchanged.
The same independent expression translated and uniformly doubled remains one row plus four context rows.
Two full independent text rows are not one fraction row; with four context rows the total is six.
Two independent equations each containing a fraction remain separate; with four context rows the total is six.
Two separate stacked numerator/bar/denominator objects remain two fraction rows; context total six.
A separately supported full body row below a valid evaluated expression cannot be classified as its limit.
Without an aligned upper endpoint the lower fraction cannot receive evaluation-limit ownership; the tall row is not certified.
A horizontally displaced lower fraction cannot be assigned to the delimiter's evaluation limits.
A mismatched body scale cannot certify oversized limit objects.

execution_policy: Run each new named case once after implementation. Only cases that actually fail may be rerun following a repair; successful cases are never rerun. One affected page-133 computational count only after all latest new cases pass.
